item.text:
Refactored the sorter into a clearer API and added executable verification.

[BucketSort.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/039_bucket_sort/BucketSort.java:1) now exposes both `sort(...)` for in-place mutation and `sortedCopy(...)` for callers that want a non-mutating path. I also pulled the supported range into constants and extracted bucket index calculation so the contract is clearer and the core flow is easier to follow.

I added [BucketSortTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/039_bucket_sort/BucketSortTest.java:1), a small self-contained test harness that checks in-place sorting, non-mutating sorting, empty input, null input, and out-of-range rejection. The demo entry point in [Main.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/039_bucket_sort/Main.java:1) still runs unchanged.

Verified with:
- `javac Main.java BucketSort.java BucketSortTest.java`
- `java Main`
- `java BucketSortTest`
